title: Elevate UI Readability: Master CSS 'line-height' for Optimal Vertical Rhythm
tweet: Boost UI readability & user experience by mastering CSS 'line-height'. Learn how to achieve perfect vertical rhythm and enhance your web typography. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UX
tip: Achieving optimal readability and a harmonious vertical rhythm in your UI is critical for user experience. The 'line-height' CSS property is your key. Instead of relying solely on unitless values, consider using 'rem' or 'em' units relative to the font-size for better scalability and consistency across responsive designs, or stick with unitless values (e.g., 1.6) which are relative to the element's font-size. Aim for values between 1.4 and 1.8 for body text, adjusting based on font characteristics, line length, and target audience. Properly set line-height prevents text from feeling too cramped or too airy, significantly improving content legibility and visual flow.
